nm:output.nm:control_stream:
;; at load time (src/model. js's own header comment: "CL 0.00342 L/h and Q ;; 0.0162 L/h become CL 0.08208 L/day and Q 0.3888 L/day" -- an exact linear ;; time rescale, already independently verified structurally equivalent in ;; MODEL_VALIDATION. md's "structure: ravulizumab $DES (ADVAN3, rescaled to ;; days)" check). This file uses the app's own day-scale THETAs directly, and ;; the synthetic dataset's TIME/RATE columns are in days to match -- same ;; model, same units the app itself uses, not a new rescale being introduced. ;; Estimation-engine validation -- ravulizumab. ;; Adapted from ../../ravulizumab.txt for POSTHOC individual estimation with ;; population parameters FIXED at their published values. ;; ;; The original control stream is in HOURS (CL 0.00342 L/h, Q 0.0162 L/h, ;; D1 2.5 h). The app works in DAYS throughout and rescales these uniformly $PROBLEM Estimation-engine validation -- ravulizumab POSTHOC $INPUT ID TIME AMT RATE DV MDV EVID CMT CENS WT AGE $DATA ravu.csv IGNORE=@ $SUBROUTINE ADVAN3 TRANS4 $PK ALLOCL = (WT/70)**0.833 ALLOV = (WT/70)**0.620 CL = THETA(1)*ALLOCL*EXP(ETA(1)) V1 = THETA(2)*ALLOV*EXP(ETA(2)) V2 = THETA(3)*ALLOV Q = THETA(4)*ALLOCL S1 = V1
;; With LIKE, $SIGMA may not be present -- residual variance carried as a ;; FIXED theta instead (proportional only, matching src/model.js's ;; SIGMA:{ADD:0, PROP:0.0239}). $ERROR IPRED = F SD = SQRT(THETA(5)*IPRED*IPRED) IF (CENS.EQ.0) THEN Y = (1/SQRT(6.283185307179586*SD*SD)) * EXP(-0.5*((DV-IPRED)/SD)**2) ELSE Y = PHI((DV-IPRED)/SD) ENDIF
$THETA 0.08208 FIX ; 1 CL L/day (0.00342 L/h x24) 3.43 FIX ; 2 V1 L 1.86 FIX ; 3 V2 L 0.3888 FIX ; 4 Q L/day (0.0162 L/h x24) 0.0239 FIX ; 5 SIGMA proportional variance $OMEGA BLOCK(2) FIX 0.0569 0.0161 0.0264 $ESTIMATION METHOD=1 LAPLACE LIKE NOABORT MAXEVAL=0 PRINT=1 POSTHOC
